name: envpilot-monorepo
description: Envpilot — secure environment variable management for teams
author: Envpilot <hello@envpilot.dev> (https://www.envpilot.dev)

scripts.dev:all: bunx --bun concurrently --names web,convex,admin,blog,docs --prefix-colors blue,green,magenta,cyan,yellow "bun --bun turbo dev --filter=@envpilot/web" "bun --bun convex dev" "bun --bun turbo dev --filter=@envpilot/admin" "bun --bun turbo dev --filter=@envpilot/blog" "bun --bun turbo dev --filter=@envpilot/docs"
scripts.build:extension: bun --bun turbo build --filter=envpilot && cd apps/vscode-extension && bunx --bun @vscode/vsce package --no-dependencies
scripts.check:all: bun --bun turbo lint typecheck build && bun --bun prettier --check .
scripts.seed: for m in seed-feature-registry seed-tier-features seed-role-registry seed-changelog; do echo "Running $m..."; bunx --bun convex run features/admin/migrations:run "{\"name\":\"$m\"}" || exit 1; done
scripts.setup: cp -n .env.example .env.local 2>/dev/null; ln -sf ../../.env.local apps/web/.env.local && ln -sf ../../.env.local apps/blog/.env.local && ln -sf ../../.env.local apps/docs/.env.local && echo 'Environment ready — edit .env.local with your values'
